hard_course_rule: All even lanes with ball_vx<=-0.60 m/s, 2.2<=ball_x<=2.4 m and -0.10<=ball_y<=-0.06 m: exactly 15 courses chosen only by initial catalog, no outcomes

arms.baseline: Negative-side bounded gain 0.8 plus sealed late-swing actor
arms.aggressive_diagnostic: Negative-side bounded gain 1.2 plus same actor; not automatically promoted
arms.shadow_choice: Veto gain 1.2 iff its independently audited parent has no contact, low pelvis or right-knee contact index 5; choice before aggressive actor outcome

procedure: Four A6000, 15 fresh difficult courses, each with independent parent and actor at each gain: 60 one-G1/ball physics episodes. Archive all candidate knee contacts and false vetoes. No candidate result used to select arm.
gate: 15/15 complete, 60/60 audited, selected option versus 0.8: >=3 net high-quality gains, mean reward gain >=0.3, no clean-foot loss, no new >4m out-of-play and all selected pelvis minima >=0.65m. Independently report unrestricted 1.2 diagnostics and risk-veto true/false positives; passing does not prove risk prediction without true risk cases.
